instruction: Take out the last application listed in your favorites dock.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing the last app (google-chrome.desktop) from the favorites dock. Initial setup creates favorites list ['thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop', 'google-chrome.desktop']. After removing the last app, the expected result is ['thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop']. Uses existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric which compares sets (order-independent).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts GNOME favorite apps using 'gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps'
Metric 'check_gnome_favorite_apps' correctly parses the string output and compares with expected list
Metric uses set equality with length check, which is appropriate for order-independent comparison
Expected value ['thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop'] is semantically correct - represents the initial list with the last app (google-chrome.desktop) removed
Complete coverage: Single-step task (remove last app) is fully verified by checking the resulting favorites list
Data flow is correct: getter extracts state → metric parses and compares → expected value matches task requirement
Metric correctly handles the 'rule' type expected parameter by accessing rule['expected'] directly
